title: DiscDiff: Latent Diffusion Model for DNA Sequence Generation
dataset: EPD-GenDNA (introduced by this paper; HuggingFace Zehui127/*)
contribution_one_line: First latent diffusion model for DNA (two-stage VAE + latent U-Net) + Absorb-Escape refinement (~15-20x S-FID drop) + the EPD-GenDNA multi-species dataset.
reproduction_approach: Fully reproduce + verify Absorb-Escape on CPU (no weights); build & structurally verify the DiscDiff LDM; document generation metrics (S-FID/CorTATA) as weight/Sei/data-gated (Colab).
related: arxiv_2603_001780 (D3LM — evaluates on this paper's EPD-GenDNA dataset)
